text:
Lena Ortiz: Weekly check-in for Siren Analytics account. Quick TL;DR: WoW tokens +25%, QoQ +55%, p95 latency increased ~40ms, spend trending up.
Sameer Shah: Noted. Do we know if the bump is read vs generate heavy?
Priya Rao: Mostly generate. Top route = /v1/chat.complete; token density per request up ~12% (longer system prompts).
Tom Keller: Also seeing increased batching delays from their side. client-side concurrency dropped which pushes larger batches server-side -> longer tails.
Sameer Shah: Error rate for chat.complete is 2.8% last 24h, primarily 504 timeouts. Recent runtime change: batch_window_ms bumped from 15 -> 30 in attempt to improve throughput.
Lena Ortiz: That config change was in the customer's SDK recommended set last week during onboarding. Could be interacting with their burst pattern.
Priya Rao: I can run a synthetic replay of their peak traffic against staging with batch_window_ms=15/30 to compare p95 and errors. Will share a graph.
Sameer Shah: Finance flagged projected month spend +48% MoM if current trend continues. Tom, can we apply a soft request cap or token quota till we stabilize?
Tom Keller: Yes. I can add a per-project soft cap: tokens_per_min = 120000 for SirenAnalytics until we finish the root-cause. Will do at 2145803000 and confirm.
infra-bot: Ticket SA-334 opened for Siren Analytics latency spike. Assigned: @Sameer, @Priya. Ops playbook link: https://redwood.internal/ops/SA-334
Lena Ortiz: Renewal risk summary: utilization strong -> positive; perf regressions -> medium risk; cost -> watch. Recommend: (1) temporary soft-token cap, (2) rapid canary reverting batch_window_ms to 15 on one node pool, (3) enablement call with customer to optimize prompt size and concurrency.
Priya Rao: Canary started 2145803300 on pool-canary-2. Running replay at 75% of peak. I'll post p50/p95/error after 15m.
Sameer Shah: If canary shows error drop and lower p95, plan to roll to 50% traffic and coordinate with Tom for billing notification.
Tom Keller: Soft cap applied 2145803000. Finance notified (cc: @Maya-Finance). Monitoring spend dashboard for immediate delta.
Priya Rao: Canary 15m snapshot: p95 down 35ms, error rate 2.8% -> 0.6%. Uploading small chart shortly.
Lena Ortiz: Great. I'll draft the enablement note: short checklist (reduce system prompt repetition, enable prefix caching, tune client concurrency). Schedule call Thurs 9am PT.
Sameer Shah: Will keep monitoring for 12h post-rollout and update the account health score.
Tom Keller: Leaving note for renewals: if perf stays improved, cost discussion can be deferred; if not, escalate to AMs for credit conversation.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks team. Closing loop after the 12h window and the enablement call. :white_check_mark:
